name: CWB Automotive Electronics Co., Ltd.
summary: CWB Automotive Electronics Co., Ltd. is a global producer specializing in electronic components and connectors for both the automotive and consumer electronics industries. Within the automotive sector, their product portfolio encompasses essential vehicle systems, including engine management, transmission, steering, chassis control, auto-body control, in-vehicle infotainment, power delivery, and exhaust systems. Complementing this, the company also caters to consumer electronics needs by supplying a variety of connector types, such as wire-to-board, wire-to-wire, board-to-board, and quick connectors, alongside FPC/FFC products. Established in 2006, the firm initially operated as CWB Automotive Zhejiang Co., Ltd. before rebranding to its current name, CWB Automotive Electronics Co., Ltd., in June 2018. While its headquarters are located in Yueqing, China, the company maintains a substantial operational presence across various Chinese cities (Taicang, Shanghai, Shenzhen, Qingdao, Suzhou, Nanjing, Dalian, Chongqing, and Wuhan). Furthermore, it extends its international reach with locations in Frankfurt, Germany; Irwindale, California, USA; and Siheung, South Korea.
